Charles Schwab is a financial services company seeking an Associate Software Development Engineer for its New Employee Recruitment Development Program. The role is designed for early-career technology talent and involves evaluating requirements, designing solutions, developing and testing code, and supporting technology deployments in an Agile environment.
Financial Services
No H1B
Responsibilities
In this role, you’ll contribute to meaningful technology initiatives that help Schwab deliver innovative, client-centric solutions
Working alongside experienced engineers in a collaborative, Agile environment, you’ll participate in the Software Development Life Cycle by evaluating requirements, designing solutions, developing and testing code, and supporting the deployment of technology enhancements
Qualification
Software Development
Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
Software Testing and Debugging
Data Structures and Algorithms
Agile Methodologies
Application Interfaces and Services
Web and Mobile Development
Database Concepts and Data Modeling
Required
Available to start full-time on February 1, 2027
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, a related discipline, or completion of a coding bootcamp or similar technical training program
Foundational knowledge of software development practices, including writing, testing, debugging, and improving code
Understanding of Software Development Life Cycle concepts, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, and deployment
Demonstrated ability to apply analytical thinking, problem-solving techniques, and fundamental data structure and algorithm concepts
Experience gained through coursework, projects, internships, work experience, or technical training in modern software development
Ability to collaborate effectively within Agile teams while communicating technical concepts clearly and professionally
Currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without employer sponsorship
Preferred
Familiarity with building or consuming application interfaces and services that enable systems to exchange information and functionality
Exposure to user-focused application design, digital experiences, web technologies, or mobile development concepts
Understanding of database concepts, data modeling principles, and working with structured data environments
Demonstrated curiosity, learning agility, and enthusiasm for exploring new technologies, tools, and approaches to solving complex problems
Evidence of leadership potential through academic projects, internships, work experience, volunteer activities, student organizations, technical initiatives, or other meaningful experiences
Interest in continuous learning, professional development, and building technical expertise in a collaborative engineering environment
